title: Granny Square Bag
description: Assemble classic granny squares into a colorful tote bag with a sturdy strap.
expectationText: A satisfying wearable project where you make granny squares, join them into panels, and add a strap to create a usable bag by the end.

steps.title: Plan your colours
steps.instruction: Choose 3 yarn colours: main colour for the bag body, a contrast colour, and a joining colour.

steps.title: Make the granny squares
steps.instruction: Crochet 12 classic granny squares using the main colour, switching contrast colour for the final round. Each square should be about 8 cm across.

steps.title: Join the squares
steps.instruction: Arrange the squares in a 3 by 4 grid. Use the joining colour and slip stitch to join squares together, creating one flat rectangle.

steps.title: Fold into bag shape
steps.instruction: Fold the rectangle in half (short side to short side) so you have a 3 by 2 grid on each side. Join the side seams.

steps.title: Make the strap
steps.instruction: Chain 80 with the joining colour. Work 3 rows of double crochet to create a sturdy strap. Repeat for the second strap.

steps.title: Attach the straps
steps.instruction: Sew one end of each strap to the inside front and the other end to the inside back of the bag. Reinforce with extra stitches.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Weave in all ends. Optionally add a button closure or leave it open for easy access.
